title: PalCraft required Minecraft assets
description: Lists files the installer extracts from the user's own Minecraft install into <game>/Mods/NativeMods/UE4SS/Mods/PalCraft/assets/. Jar paths and index keys keep their vanilla relative path; a leading 'assets/' (jar) is stripped so both land under assets/minecraft/...

kind.description: jar: one file inside versions/<v>/<v>.jar (path = 'assets/minecraft/textures/...'). jar_prefix: every file whose jar path starts with path (use a trailing '/'). sound: one key of assets/indexes/<id>.json 'objects' (path = 'minecraft/sounds/mob/creeper/say1.ogg', also 'minecraft/sounds.json', 'minecraft/lang/en_us.json'); resolved to assets/objects/<hash[0:2]>/<hash>. sound_prefix: every index key starting with path.

packs.description: Entry is extracted when ANY listed pack is installed (core is always installed).

optional.description: If true a missing file is reported as informational instead of a warning.
